import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the workspace structure
class gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('q_num', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
                ('q_den', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
                ('dsum', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
                ('size', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('terms_used', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('sum_plain', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_workspace)
gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_workspace)]

def allocate_and_free_workspace(n):
    try:
        if n <= 0:
            print("Error: n must be a positive integer.")
            return False
        # Allocate workspace
        workspace = gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_alloc(n)
        if not workspace:
            print("Error: Failed to allocate workspace.")
            return False
        # Free workspace
        gsl.gsl_sum_levin_utrunc_free(workspace)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error: {e}')
        return False

def assert_test():
    # Test with valid input
    assert allocate_and_free_workspace(10) == True
    # Test with zero input (should fail gracefully)
    assert allocate_and_free_workspace(0) == False
    # Test with negative input (should fail gracefully)
    assert allocate_and_free_workspace(-5) == False
    # Test with large input
    assert allocate_and_free_workspace(1000000) == True

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
